digest.component_or_area: ticket create/edit with plan-review admission guard
propositions: When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) at save time and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning must be displayed immediately to alert the user that plan review will reject the submission until the description is shortened.
The save-time warning must read the same config key as the existing plan-review admission guard (det_floor.py) to maintain single-sourcing of the threshold and prevent divergent enforcement.
The warning must be emitted through all three surfaces (CLI stderr, library logger, MCP result field) without blocking or altering the ticket write operation.
No warning must appear when the gate is disabled, when the description is within the cap, or when the ticket type is exempt from plan review.
The warning implementation must reuse the existing _plan_review_gate_applies() probe to ensure the warning promise aligns with the actual claim-gate behavior.
